top_signals.title: Oil prices ease but are set for 10% weekly gain as Trump mulls 'bigger than ever' attack on Iran
top_signals.summary: Oil prices dropped by around 4% on Friday, but remained on track for a weekly jump of 10% as the U.S.-Iran war continued to escalate.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Russian online retailer Wildberries becomes target for Ukraine’s drones
top_signals.summary: Strikes on Wildberries have killed nine people and left small sellers facing millions of roubles in losses
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Gulf States Seen Splurging on Debt to Build New Hormuz Bypasses
top_signals.summary: Traders are preparing for a spike in borrowing from Persian Gulf nations as the region’s oil exporters seek financing to build costly bypasses around the Strait of Hormuz.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Dollar Set for Best Week in a Month as Haven Flows Offer Support
top_signals.summary: The dollar is heading for its best week in a month as investors return to the traditional haven amid heightened geopolitical tensions.

top_signals.title: Welcome to the era of financial candyfloss
